title: Start parallel delivery from the acceptance criteria, without a separate interface agreement
problem: Every mission with two workstreams spends a planning step agreeing a versioned interface before delivery starts. Integration is verified afterwards in any case.
hypothesis: If parallel workstreams start from the acceptance criteria and integration verification stays as it is, missions will finish with fewer worker invocations and no more defects reaching an accepted result.
expected_benefit: One fewer planning step per mission; delivery starts sooner.
possible_regressions: The two workstreams interpret the shared record differently, which only shows at integration and has to be reworked
More integration failures and a longer critical path when that happens
change_summary: Removes the interface-agreement step: no contract task, and delivery workstreams take the acceptance criteria as input instead of a pinned contract.
